trust one's instincts: When you feel that a stranger online is not honest, you should trust your instincts and stop chatting.
當你覺得網路上的陌生人不誠實時，你應該相信直覺並停止聊天。
trust in God: During the long war, many people continued to trust in God and prayed every night for peace.
在漫長的戰爭期間，許多人仍持續信靠上帝，每晚為和平禱告。
trust someone with a secret: Amy is the only friend I would trust with a secret, because she has never told anyone what I said.
艾咪是我唯一願意把秘密託付給她的朋友，因為她從來沒有把我說的話告訴任何人。
trust the process: Don't doubt every step of your training plan; just trust the process, and the results will come with time.
不要懷疑你訓練計畫的每一步，只要相信過程，成果自然會隨時間到來。
take on trust: I cannot check every fact in the report myself, so I have to take what the scientists say on trust.
我無法親自查證報告中的每一項事實，所以只能姑且相信科學家們的說法。
a position of trust: As a school nurse, she holds a position of trust, so parents expect her to keep students' information private.
身為校護，她擔任受信任的職位，所以家長期望她為學生的資料保密。
try one's luck: After failing the audition last year, Ben decided to try his luck again at this year's singing contest.
去年試鏡失敗後，班決定在今年的歌唱比賽中再碰碰運氣。
try one's patience: The little boy kept asking the same question again and again, which really began to try my patience.
那個小男孩一再問同樣的問題，這真的開始考驗我的耐心。
try a case: The famous judge will try a case next month involving a company that polluted the river for years.
這位知名法官下個月將審理一宗案件，涉及一家多年來污染河川的公司。
try one's hand at: After retiring from her office job, my aunt decided to try her hand at painting and now joins art classes.
從辦公室工作退休後，我阿姨決定嘗試畫畫，現在都去上美術課。
try on clothes: My sister likes to try on clothes for hours at the mall, but she rarely buys anything in the end.
我姊姊喜歡在購物中心試穿衣服好幾個小時，但最後她很少買任何東西。
try out for the team: Kevin practiced shooting every day after school because he wanted to try out for the team in September.
凱文每天放學後都練習投籃，因為他想在九月參加校隊選拔。
try someone for murder: The court will try the man for murder after the police found his fingerprints on the knife.
警方在刀子上找到他的指紋後，法院將以謀殺罪審判那名男子。
tug at one's heartstrings: Videos of lost puppies finding their way home always tug at my heartstrings and make me cry.
走失小狗找到回家路的影片總是扣人心弦，讓我哭出來。
tug at one's sleeve: The little girl began to tug at her mother's sleeve and pointed excitedly at the ice cream truck.
那個小女孩開始拉她媽媽的袖子，並興奮地指著冰淇淋車。
tug of war: On sports day, our class won the tug of war because everyone pulled the rope together at the same time.
運動會那天，我們班贏得了拔河比賽，因為每個人同時一起拉繩子。
tug a boat: A small but powerful ship was sent out to tug a boat that had lost its engine near the harbor.
一艘小而有力的船被派出去拖一艘在港口附近失去引擎的船。
prices tumbled: After the new phone came out, prices tumbled for the old model, so I bought one at half price.
新手機推出後，舊款的價格暴跌，所以我用半價買了一支。
tumble down the stairs: The child lost his balance and began to tumble down the stairs, but luckily he only hurt his elbow.
那個孩子失去平衡開始滾下樓梯，但幸好他只傷到手肘。
the economy tumbled: When the virus spread around the world, the economy tumbled and many small shops had to close.
當病毒在全球擴散時，經濟重挫，許多小商店不得不關門。
tumble into bed: After the long flight home, I was so tired that I tumbled into bed without even taking off my shoes.
長途飛行回家後，我累到連鞋子都沒脫就倒頭就睡。
tumble to the truth: It took the detective a long time to tumble to the truth that the quiet maid was the real thief.
偵探花了很長時間才恍然大悟，原來那位安靜的女傭才是真正的小偷。
walls came tumbling down: When the strong earthquake hit the old village, walls came tumbling down and people ran into the streets.
當強烈地震襲擊那座古老村莊時，高牆倒下，人們紛紛跑到街上。
tune in to the program: Every Sunday night, my grandfather likes to tune in to the program about old Taiwanese songs on the radio.
每週日晚上，我爺爺喜歡收聽廣播上那個關於台灣老歌的節目。
tune out: When my uncles start arguing about politics at dinner, I just tune out, even though I am still sitting at the table.
當我叔叔們在晚餐時開始爭論政治時，我就充耳不聞，即使我仍然坐在餐桌旁。
tune up the engine: Before our long road trip around the island, Dad took the car to the garage to tune up the engine.
在我們環島長途自駕旅行之前，爸爸把車開到修車廠調校引擎。
be in tune with: A good teacher should be in tune with the needs of her students and notice when they feel stressed.
好老師應該與學生的需求合拍，並在他們感到壓力時察覺到。
change one's tune: At first, my father hated the idea of getting a dog, but he changed his tune after meeting the cute puppy.
起初我爸爸很討厭養狗的主意，但見到那隻可愛的小狗後他就改變說法了。
tune a guitar: Before the concert started, the musician took a few minutes to tune a guitar that sounded slightly wrong.
音樂會開始前，那位音樂家花了幾分鐘為一把聲音有點不準的吉他調音。
fine-tune a plan: We still have a week before the school fair, so we can fine-tune a plan for decorating our booth.
距離園遊會還有一週，所以我們可以微調布置攤位的計畫。
